title: Crib breaks all-male lineup with addition of former MYMP vocalist Mela Ravanilla
summary: After more than two decades of performing together, the formerly all-male band, Crib, added its first female member, Mela Ravanilla, who used to be with MYMP (Make Your Momma Proud).
